## Statute
§63(c)(2)(A)(ii) - The basic standard deduction is 200% of the dollar amount in effect under subparagraph (C) for the taxable year in the case of a surviving spouse (as defined in section 2(a)).

## Reasoning
Section 63(c)(2)(A)(ii) applies specifically to a "surviving spouse" as defined in section 2(a). A surviving spouse is a taxpayer whose spouse died during the taxable year. In this case, Alice and Bob have been married since Feb 3rd, 2017, and they file a joint return for 2017. Alice is married to Bob who is alive during the taxable year. Therefore, Alice is a married individual filing a joint return, not a surviving spouse. Section 63(c)(2)(A)(i) would apply to Alice (joint return), not 63(c)(2)(A)(ii). The claim that 63(c)(2)(A)(ii) applies to Alice is false.

## Answer
Answer: Contradiction
